We understand that choosing the right sample preparation equipment and methods can be challenging.
That’s why we offer complimentary sample testing services to help you ensure that your samples are
processed using the most effective techniques.

best sample preparation solution for your specific needs.

mills, high-energy ball mills, ring and puck mills, and XRF pellet presses enabling us to process
virtually any sample type. It's easy to set up a visit either virtually or in person where you can
watch these instruments process the material of your choice.

We offer 3 options for sample processing:

• Send in your sample: physical testing of your sample with shared results

• Visit our facility: see your sample processing in action

To request sample processing, [complete the form][95] and include it with your sample.

a member from our team. Email us at [sampleprep@coleparmer.com][96] or contact +1.732.623.00465.

composition alone leaves a critical gap because oxygen, nitrogen, and hydrogen remain hidden within

product quality throughout production.

## A global technology leader in electrification and automation

By connecting our engineering and digitalization expertise, we help industries run at high
performance, while becoming more efficient, productive and sustainable so they outperform.

### Electrification

The world needs more power with lower emissions. As a global technology leader in electrical
distribution and management, we bring electrification solutions together to accelerate
decarbonization and increase energy efficiency.

### Automation

ABB's Process Automation business offers a broad range of solutions for process and hybrid
industries, including industry-specific integrated automation, electrification and digital
solutions, control technologies, software and advanced services, as well as measurement & analytics,
and marine offerings.

### Motors and Drives

ABB, global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and
sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy
efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies.

### Power Conversion and Control

ABB power converters and controllers help customers to generate and use energy efficiently. They are
designed for reliable operation even under the most demanding conditions, and for low life cycle
costs.

### Renewable Power

At the heart of the energy transition lies the expansion and reliable integration of solar, wind,
hydro, geothermal and other non-fossil energy sources. Building smarter, more adaptable energy
infrastructure can help leverage the immense potential of renewables.

### Robotics

ABB Robotics is one of the world’s leading robotics suppliers, offering a comprehensive and
integrated portfolio that includes industrial and collaborative robots, autonomous mobile robots
(AMRs), controllers, application solutions, services, and equipment.

# Engineering Services

Analysis is critical to product performance, quality, and mission assurance. There are many reasons
to perform it.

You know you need to do more analysis. But there's never enough time, money, resources, or schedule.
Let AEi Systems tackle your analysis challenges.

[
[Service Image]

##### Worst Case Circuit Analysis

Comprehensive analysis to identify and eliminate potential design flaws under worst case conditions,
ensuring robust and reliable designs.

][36]
[
[Service Image]

##### Power Integrity Analysis

Analysis of power distribution networks, VRMs, target impedance, and decoupling to ensure stable and
reliable power delivery across your system.

][37]
[
[Service Image]

##### Signal Integrity Analysis

Analysis of signal transmission paths, interconnects, timing, interface compatibility, and PCB
layout to ensure minimal distortion, noise margins, and reliable high-speed data performance.

][38]
[
[Service Image]

##### Stress & Derating Analysis

Evaluation of component electrical and thermal performance under various stress & derating
conditions to ensure reliability and longevity in demanding environments.

][39]
[
[Service Image]

##### Reliability Analysis

MTBF (FIT-Rate) and Failure Mode Effects (FMECA/FMEA) assessments to Mil Standards, by experienced
experts, get this analysis completed quickly and accurately.

][40]
[
[Service Image]

##### Radiation Analysis

Assessment of circuit and component susceptibility to radiation effects (SEE, SEU, SET, TID, DD) for
space and missile missions.

][41]
[
[Service Image]

##### PCB Layout Services

Design and optimization of printed circuit board layouts to ensure signal integrity, power
distribution, manufacturability, and compliance with industry standards for reliable electronic
performance.

][42]
[
[Service Image]

##### Expert Review Services

WCCA and stress report reviews, CID+ PCB Layout reviews, and early-stage design reviews to catch
issues before formal WCCA, saving time and cost.

][43]
[
[Service Image]

##### Training

Workshops and training on WCCA to empower your management and design teams with the skills needed
for effective analysis and analysis review.

][44]

## Need to Meet Your Analysis Deadlines?

Partner with AEi Systems for expert analysis and support. Let us help you meet schedule, on budget,
all while achieving robust, high-performance reliability.

[Contact Us Today][45]

AEi Systems provides a tremendous time and cost advantage compared with other resources. We give you
a better product and an analysis done more quickly and at a lower overall cost.

We are happy to work in conjunction with in-house resources, as a parallel asset, and within your
budget. If you think we can benefit your company or program please do give us a call.

tap‑to‑pay options for easy checkout.

in‑person payments quickly and securely.

manual payments through any web browser.

offering a low‑cost, dependable digital alternative.

Most industrial projects get slowed down by layers, overengineering, and unnecessary complexity.

We take a different approach. You work directly with an experienced engineer to solve problems
quickly and build solutions that actually fit your operation.
‍

✅ **Direct Access** – Work directly with a decision-maker from day one. No layers, no delays.
‍

✅ **Built for your setup** – Solutions designed around your machines and processes, not forced into
a rigid system.
‍

✅ **Fast, focused execution** – Get results quickly without turning your project into a long,
drawn-out effort.

system.

decision-making.

integrations to enhance your manufacturing processes. Our expertise ensures seamless integration and
improved efficiency across your operations. We'll work with nearly any platform to ensure you get
the support you need.

integration, analytics, and Industry 4.0. From telemetry to dashboards, we help manufacturers
improve efficiency and make smarter decisions in real-time with the help of our modern and flexible
software.

flexible, tailored solutions that go unmatched by proprietary solutions.

**✅ Affordability and Transparency** – Tailored solutions at a fraction of the cost of generic
offerings from large vendors.

**✅ Your Preferred Vendor **– We select the best technology for your needs, optimizing cost,
functionality, vendor preference, and integrations.

**✅ Fast & Friendly Service **– Whether you need a fast turnaround or a flexible rollout, we adjust
to your timeline and make collaboration seamless.

# Home

### ศูนย์วิจัยและพัฒนาเทคโนโลยีนิวเคลียร์ (ศน.)
* [Dr. Thitirat Rattanawongwiboon of Material Science Lab]
  Dr. Thitirat Rattanawongwiboon of Material Science Lab
* ขอแสดงความยินดีกับนักวิจัย จากศูนย์วิจัยและพัฒนาเทคโนโลยีนิวเคลียร์ สทน. ที่คว้ารางวัลการวิจัยแห่งชาติ ประจำปีงบประมาณ
  2569 จากสำนักงานการวิจัยแห่งชาติ (วช.) ซึ่งประกาศผลเมื่อวันที่ 28 พฤศจิกายน 2568 จำนวนรวม 7 ผลงาน
* [[Vichai Puripunyavanich in the tissue culture lab. His research teams focuses on plant mutation
  breeding using ionizing radiation to develop novel varieties with desired traits.]][18]
  Vichai Puripunyavanich in the tissue culture lab. His research teams focuses on plant mutation
  breeding using ionizing radiation to develop novel varieties with desired traits.
* [[ดร. ศักดิ์ชัย หลักสี
  กับงานวิจัยการประยุกต์ใช้เทคโนโลยีนิวเคลียร์ในกระบวนการสังเคราะห์วัสดุขั้นสูงเพื่อพลิกโฉมวงการนาโนเทคโนโลยีและนวัตกรรมสีเ
  ขียวสู่อนาคตที่ยั่งยืน จากระบบนำส่งยานาโนไฮบริดที่ช่วยเสริมฤทธิ์ต้านมะเร็งอย่างทรงประสิทธิภาพ
  สู่เทคโนโลยีเม็ดบีดกักเก็บสารออกฤทธิ์ที่ช่วยยืดอายุผักและผลไม้ และวัสดุตัวเร่งปฏิกิริยาเชิงแสงที่ช่วยบำบัดน้ำเสีย
  ซึ่งเทคโนโลยีรังสีคือพลังขับเคลื่อนการสร้างวัสดุนาโนอัจฉริยะเพื่อสุขภาพ อาหาร และสิ่งแวดล้อมอย่างยั่งยืน]][19]
  ดร. ศักดิ์ชัย หลักสี สังเคราะห์วัสดุขั้นสูงด้วยเทคโนโลยีนิวเคลียร์เพื่อนวัตกรรมสีเขียวสู่อนาคตที่ยั่งยืน รวมถึงสารต้านมะเร็ง
  สารออกฤทธิ์ที่ช่วยยืดอายุผักและผลไม้ และวัสดุช่วยบำบัดน้ำเสีย
* [[ดร. ธนกร แสงทวีสิน มุ่งมั่นพัฒนาการใช้ประโยชน์ผักตบชวาโดยกระบวนการทางรังสี เพื่อการสังเคราะวัสดุคาร์บอนขนาดจิ๋ว
  (carbon dots) ด้วยรังสีแกมมา ที่สามารถนำไปใช้ประโยชน์ที่หลากหลาย อาทิ ฟิล์มกรองแสง ฟิล์มถนอมอาหาร
  แผ่นเยื่อเลือกผ่านเพื่อเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพการนำไฟฟ้าในตัวเก็บประจุ และ อีกมากมาย]][20]
  ดร. ธนกร แสงทวีสิน มุ่งมั่นพัฒนาการใช้ประโยชน์ผักตบชวาโดยกระบวนการทางรังสี เพื่อการสังเคราะวัสดุคาร์บอนขนาดจิ๋ว
  (carbon dots) ด้วยรังสีแกมมา ที่สามารถนำไปใช้ประโยชน์ที่หลากหลาย อาทิ ฟิล์มกรองแสง ฟิล์มถนอมอาหาร
  แผ่นเยื่อเลือกผ่านเพื่อเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพการนำไฟฟ้าในตัวเก็บประจุ และ อีกมากมาย
* [[Dr. Waleeporn Pongkua and her research on rice cultivation for greenhouse gas reduction.]][21]
  Dr. Waleeporn Pongkua and her research on rice cultivation for greenhouse gas reduction.

## What is Californium?

Californium is a soft, metallic radioactive element first synthesized in 1950 at the University of
California at Berkeley’s Radiation Laboratory. One of its isotopes, californium-252 or Cf-252, is a
powerful spontaneous emitter of neutrons. The isotope is widely used in many industries for
initiating a nuclear chain reaction, oil well-logging analysis, material scanning (PGNAA and PINS)
and medical applications.

## Experts in Neutron Sources

Frontier Technology Corporation has over 40 years of experience providing custom neutron sources,
Type-A shipping containers, and neutron shielding solutions to customers in many industries. All of
our sources comply with 10CFR50, Appendix B standards and meet requirements for IAEA Special Form
Certification from the USDOT. We also comply with ODH, Nuclear Regulatory Commission, ISO 2919,
ASTM, and ANSI standards.

## Who We Are

Because our culture is focused on long-term relationships (with both our clients and our employees),
we are uniquely positioned to solve problems for manufacturers. We are independent and not owned by
an OEM, so we can offer innovative solutions without biases to simply and cost-effectively improve
plant operations. We’ve also built up a wide range of in-house capabilities that fill in the gaps
where other integrators stop short, adding more value and accountability to every project.

###### Our People

At LSI, our core values – service, integrity, and excellence – support our goal to provide the
highest level of benefit in what we do for our customers. Our employees are rewarded for providing
service to the customer first, acting with integrity, and showcasing technical excellence. LSI
employees value hard work and being part of something special.

###### Our Methods

We utilize project execution methodology and metrics tracking to ensure each job’s success. We
always strive for the right application of the proper technology for the purpose required. LSI is
large enough to execute multiple, multi-million dollar projects simultaneously, but small enough to
be responsive to our customers’ needs. We manage each project by focusing on quality, cost, and
schedule. A gap or compromise in any of these three areas will result in projects failing to meet
expectations.

###### Our Reputation

Reputation in the engineering services business is critical to long-term success. LSI knows that we
must excel on every project we do to earn the privilege of being invited back to provide more
services in the future. We depend on repeat business and realize that “we are only as good as our
last project.” We are proud of the fact that our very first customer from 1985 is still an active
and growing customer today.

# Microsoft Activation Scripts (MAS)

An open-source Windows and Office activator featuring HWID, Ohook, TSforge, and Online KMS
activation methods, along with advanced troubleshooting.

### Activation Methods[][23]
* Method 1: PowerShell (Recommended)
* Method 2: Traditional (Offline)

**This method is the most convenient and works on Windows 8.1, 10, and 11.**
1. Click the **Start Menu**, type `PowerShell`, and open it.
2. Copy and paste the code below and press **Enter.**

`
irm https://get.activated.win | iex
`
3. In the menu that appears, type the number corresponding to one of the **Green** options.

**Having trouble? (Blocked by ISP or Old Windows)**

**If the command is blocked:**
Some ISPs block the URL. Use this command to bypass DNS blocks (Windows 10/11 only):

`
iex (curl.exe -s --doh-url https://1.1.1.1/dns-query https://get.activated.win | Out-String)
`

**If you receive a TLS/SSL Error (Older Windows):**
If you are on an old build of Windows 8.1 or 10, run this command *before* the main command:

`
[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol=[Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
`

**Still not working?** You need to use a VPN like [Cloudflare WARP][24] or follow method 2 instead.

**Use this method if you prefer downloading a file or cannot use the PowerShell method.**
1. Download the script:
   * [**MAS_AIO.cmd**][25] (Direct script)
   * [**MAS_AIO.zip**][26] (If the direct script is blocked by your browser)
2. Run the `MAS_AIO.cmd` file.
3. In the menu that appears, type the number corresponding to one of the **Green** options.

tip
* Some ISPs/DNS providers block access to our domains. You can bypass this by enabling
  [DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH)][27] in your browser.
* **Having trouble?** Connect with us [here][28].
note
* The `irm` command in PowerShell downloads a script from a specified URL, and the `iex` command
  executes it.
* Always double-check the URL before executing the command and verify the source is trustworthy when
  manually downloading files.
* Be cautious of third parties spreading malware disguised as MAS by altering the URL in the
  PowerShell command.

## Features[][33]
* **HWID (Digital License):** Permanently activate Windows.
* **Ohook:** Permanently activate Office.
* **TSforge:** Permanently activate Windows, ESU, and Office.
* **Online KMS:** Activate Windows/Office for 180 days (Lifetime with renewal task).
* Advanced activation troubleshooting.
* $OEM$ folders for pre-activation.
* Change Windows edition.
* Change Office edition.
* Check Windows/Office activation status.
* Available in All-In-One and separate file versions.
* Fully open source and based on batch scripts.
* Fewer antivirus detections.

# Microsoft Activation Scripts (MAS)

An open-source Windows and Office activator featuring HWID, Ohook, TSforge, and Online KMS
activation methods, along with advanced troubleshooting.

### Activation Methods[][23]
* Method 1: PowerShell (Recommended)
* Method 2: Traditional (Offline)

**This method is the most convenient and works on Windows 8.1, 10, and 11.**
1. Click the **Start Menu**, type `PowerShell`, and open it.
2. Copy and paste the code below and press **Enter.**

`
irm https://get.activated.win | iex
`
3. In the menu that appears, type the number corresponding to one of the **Green** options.

**Having trouble? (Blocked by ISP or Old Windows)**

**If the command is blocked:**
Some ISPs block the URL. Use this command to bypass DNS blocks (Windows 10/11 only):

`
iex (curl.exe -s --doh-url https://1.1.1.1/dns-query https://get.activated.win | Out-String)
`

**If you receive a TLS/SSL Error (Older Windows):**
If you are on an old build of Windows 8.1 or 10, run this command *before* the main command:

`
[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol=[Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
`

**Still not working?** You need to use a VPN like [Cloudflare WARP][24] or follow method 2 instead.

**Use this method if you prefer downloading a file or cannot use the PowerShell method.**
1. Download the script:
   * [**MAS_AIO.cmd**][25] (Direct script)
   * [**MAS_AIO.zip**][26] (If the direct script is blocked by your browser)
2. Run the `MAS_AIO.cmd` file.
3. In the menu that appears, type the number corresponding to one of the **Green** options.

tip
* Some ISPs/DNS providers block access to our domains. You can bypass this by enabling
  [DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH)][27] in your browser.
* **Having trouble?** Connect with us [here][28].
note
* The `irm` command in PowerShell downloads a script from a specified URL, and the `iex` command
  executes it.
* Always double-check the URL before executing the command and verify the source is trustworthy when
  manually downloading files.
* Be cautious of third parties spreading malware disguised as MAS by altering the URL in the
  PowerShell command.

* **TSforge:** Permanently activate Windows, ESU, and Office.
* **Online KMS:** Activate Windows/Office for 180 days (Lifetime with renewal task).
* Advanced activation troubleshooting.
* $OEM$ folders for pre-activation.
* Change Windows edition.
* Change Office edition.
* Check Windows/Office activation status.

### [Fresh Look at Polarized Deuterons at the Nuclotron/NICA & HIAF and Beyond][47]

B. Gou, V. P. Ladygin, N. N. Nikolaev, F. Rathmann, A. J. Silenko, Yu. N. Uzikov

Being a spin-1 particle, the deuteron, when polarized, offers access to a wide range of interesting
tensor observables. A quest for tensor asymmetries is at the heart of the spin physics with
polarized deuterons at future colliders, and calls for frequent tensor polarization flips in storage
rings or in deuterium targets.
Here we focus on the JEDI developed technique of the Fourier analysis of the horizontal polarization
oscillations under continuous radiofrequency driven spin flips. The so generated time-stamped
oscillating helicity of stored particles paves the way to the nucleon/nucleus spin structure studies
and to the search for the parity violation. Simultaneously a whole set of tensor spin asymmetries,
including the off-diagonal ones needed for searches for the T-violation beyond the Standard Model,
will be produced.
A crucial ingredient is a long polarization lifetime, and we report the first analytic treatment of
decoherence of tensor polarization under continuous radiofrequency spin flips. The principal
conclusion is that at low- and intermediate-energy accelerators the deuteron polarization lifetime
could be in the ballpark of several hours, making the oscillating polarization approach viable at
Nuclotron/NICA and HIAF.
We comment on a utility of the flattop spin-tensor dichroism via oscillations in the cross section
of interaction of deuterons in the internal target as a monitor of the tensor polarization.
Simultaneously, the dichroism effect can be used for measuring the spin precession frequences and as
a comagnetometer to synchronize spin phases of colliding bunches in a collider.

### [Neutron Activation Analysis – Main Advancements in Trace Element Detection in Food Samples][51]

Inga Zinicovscaia, Dmitrii Grozdov

As a high-priority issue for sustainable global development, food security requires attention to
both the quantity and quality of food. Trace elements pose a complex challenge for food security in
this context; they can be beneficial as essential micronutrients or harmful as toxic contaminants
that compromise food safety and public health. Consequently, advanced analytical tools, particularly
elemental analysis, are employed to verify food quality, authenticity, and traceability. Since its
first application in 1936 neutron activation analysis has proven to be a powerful analytical
technique for determining the elemental composition of a wide variety of samples. The method's
widespread adoption is due to its numerous benefits, including its multi-element character,
non-destructive nature, high sensitivity and precision, ultra-low detection limits, and simple
sample preparation. These advantages have led to its use in critical fields such as food safety,
agriculture, and environmental monitoring. The paper provides an introduction to the biological role
and toxicity of trace elements, discusses the fundamental principles, strengths, and limitations of
neutron activation analysis, and presents an overview of NAA applications in food analysis, along
with a summary of key findings.

### [Fresh Look at Polarized Deuterons at the Nuclotron/NICA & HIAF and Beyond][47]

B. Gou, V. P. Ladygin, N. N. Nikolaev, F. Rathmann, A. J. Silenko, Yu. N. Uzikov

Being a spin-1 particle, the deuteron, when polarized, offers access to a wide range of interesting
tensor observables. A quest for tensor asymmetries is at the heart of the spin physics with
polarized deuterons at future colliders, and calls for frequent tensor polarization flips in storage
rings or in deuterium targets.
Here we focus on the JEDI developed technique of the Fourier analysis of the horizontal polarization
oscillations under continuous radiofrequency driven spin flips. The so generated time-stamped
oscillating helicity of stored particles paves the way to the nucleon/nucleus spin structure studies
and to the search for the parity violation. Simultaneously a whole set of tensor spin asymmetries,
including the off-diagonal ones needed for searches for the T-violation beyond the Standard Model,
will be produced.
A crucial ingredient is a long polarization lifetime, and we report the first analytic treatment of
decoherence of tensor polarization under continuous radiofrequency spin flips. The principal
conclusion is that at low- and intermediate-energy accelerators the deuteron polarization lifetime
could be in the ballpark of several hours, making the oscillating polarization approach viable at
Nuclotron/NICA and HIAF.
We comment on a utility of the flattop spin-tensor dichroism via oscillations in the cross section
of interaction of deuterons in the internal target as a monitor of the tensor polarization.
Simultaneously, the dichroism effect can be used for measuring the spin precession frequences and as
a comagnetometer to synchronize spin phases of colliding bunches in a collider.

### [Neutron Activation Analysis – Main Advancements in Trace Element Detection in Food Samples][51]

Inga Zinicovscaia, Dmitrii Grozdov

As a high-priority issue for sustainable global development, food security requires attention to
both the quantity and quality of food. Trace elements pose a complex challenge for food security in
this context; they can be beneficial as essential micronutrients or harmful as toxic contaminants
that compromise food safety and public health. Consequently, advanced analytical tools, particularly
elemental analysis, are employed to verify food quality, authenticity, and traceability. Since its
first application in 1936 neutron activation analysis has proven to be a powerful analytical
technique for determining the elemental composition of a wide variety of samples. The method's
widespread adoption is due to its numerous benefits, including its multi-element character,
non-destructive nature, high sensitivity and precision, ultra-low detection limits, and simple
sample preparation. These advantages have led to its use in critical fields such as food safety,
agriculture, and environmental monitoring. The paper provides an introduction to the biological role
and toxicity of trace elements, discusses the fundamental principles, strengths, and limitations of
neutron activation analysis, and presents an overview of NAA applications in food analysis, along
with a summary of key findings.

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

[ Plug in our data ][42]

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

# Sanchar Saathi Portal – TAFCOP, Download App & Check SIM Card Details 2026

The **[Sanchar Saathi Portal][18]** is a citizen-friendly initiative by the Department of
Telecommunications (DoT), Government of India, aimed at protecting mobile users from fraud, misuse,
and mobile theft. Through this platform, users can check how many SIM cards are linked to their
Aadhaar, verify the authenticity of their mobile devices, and even block lost or stolen phones. The
integrated system also ensures that telecom services remain transparent and accountable.

In an era of rising digital threats, identity theft, and SIM-related scams, Sanchar Saathi empowers
users to monitor and manage their telecom connections securely.

## **What Is Sanchar Saathi Portal?**

Sanchar Saathi is both a web portal and a mobile app that provides multiple services related to
mobile security and SIM verification. It combines several key modules developed by the DoT to
strengthen consumer safety:
* **CEIR (Central Equipment Identity Register) –** a database that tracks and blocks lost or stolen
  mobile phones.
* **TAFCOP (Telecom Analytics for Fraud Management and Consumer Protection)** – a platform that
  helps users check the number of active SIMs issued in their name.
* **KYM (Know Your Mobile) – **a service that allows users to verify if a mobile device is genuine
  or blacklisted.

The Sanchar Saathi Portal ([www.sancharsaathi.gov.in][27]) allows users to access these features
under a single interface, making it easy to check SIM cards, block stolen phones, and safeguard
personal data.

## **Why Sanchar Saathi Portal is in News**

Recently, the Sanchar Saathi App came into the spotlight when the Department of Telecommunications
issued new directions on 28 November 2025. According to the latest rules, all mobile phone
manufacturers and importers must pre-install the Sanchar Saathi app on every new device sold in
India.

This step aims to make security features accessible to every smartphone user and ensure that
individuals can quickly report lost devices, verify IMEI numbers, and prevent SIM misuse without
needing separate apps or websites.

## **Objectives of Sanchar Saathi Portal**

The main objectives of the Sanchar Saathi Portal are:
* To protect citizens from fake, duplicate, or tampered mobile devices
* To prevent SIM frauds and identity misuse
* To help users report lost or stolen phones easily
* To support cyber safety and block suspicious activity
* To improve transparency in the telecom sector by letting users monitor their own connections

By integrating TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi and CEIR services, the portal strengthens both consumer
awareness and network-level protection.

## **Understanding TAFCOP – Sanchar Saathi Know Your Mobile Connection**

TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi is an essential component of the Sanchar Saathi system. It enables users to
find out how many SIM cards are linked to their identity using their Aadhaar or mobile number.

Here’s how you can use the TAFCOP portal for Aadhaar card mobile number check:
1. Visit the official [**TAFCOP Portal**][28]
2. Enter your mobile number and click on Generate OTP
3. Verify the OTP received on your registered phone
4. The system will display all active SIM cards associated with your Aadhaar number
5. If you find an unknown connection, you can report or block it directly from the portal

This process, also known as Sanchar Saathi SIM Check, ensures that your telecom identity is not
misused for unauthorized activities.

## **Central Equipment Identity Register (CEIR) – Role and Functions**

The CEIR system plays a crucial role in maintaining the national IMEI database. Every mobile phone
has a unique IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identity) number. The CEIR helps ensure that only
genuine devices operate on Indian telecom networks.

**Functions of CEIR include:**
* Blocking lost or stolen phones across all Indian networks
* Preventing the use of fake or cloned IMEI numbers
* Assisting police and security agencies in tracing stolen devices
* Allowing users to unblock recovered devices

Through CEIR, users can visit the Sanchar Saathi Portal, enter their IMEI number, and block a stolen
phone instantly. This helps reduce mobile theft and the illegal sale of blacklisted devices.

# WOKWI SIMULATION PROJECTS

An online simulation platform for designing, testing, and debugging electronics projects with
microcontrollers like Arduino, ESP32, and Raspberry Pi Pico—no physical hardware required.

[Explore Wokwi Official Site][3]

## Core Features

Wokwi provides a powerful, user-friendly environment that enables users to design and debug embedded
systems with ease.

[Real-time Simulation Icon]

### Real-time Simulation

Observe system behavior with instant visual feedback from your circuit.

[Code Editor Icon]

### Integrated Code Editor

Write, test, and debug your firmware directly in the browser.

[Component Library Icon]

### Vast Component Library

Access a huge library of sensors, displays, and other modules.

[Sharing Icon]

### Collaboration & Sharing

Distribute and demonstrate projects easily via simple shareable links.

## How to Use Wokwi Simulation
1. **Connnect the Modules**
   * Follow the schematic diagram provided.
   * Use the left side (sketch.ino) to write your Arduino code.
2. ** Add Components**
   * Click the “+” button on the right side of the screen.
   * Select components such as LEDs, resistors, push buttons, sensors, etc.
   * Drag and drop the selected components into the virtual workspace.
3. **Wire the Components**
   * Click on a component's pin and drag a wire to the appropriate Arduino pin.
   * Ensure all connections match the schematic for correct functionality.
4. ** Run the Simulation**
   * Click the green "Play" button at the top to start the simulation.
   * Observe your circuit in action.
   * Click “Pause” to stop the simulation when needed.
5. ** Save or Share Your Project**
   * Click the Save icon to store your project.

# WOKWI SIMULATION PROJECTS

An online simulation platform for designing, testing, and debugging electronics projects with
microcontrollers like Arduino, ESP32, and Raspberry Pi Pico—no physical hardware required.

[Explore Wokwi Official Site][3]

## Core Features

Wokwi provides a powerful, user-friendly environment that enables users to design and debug embedded
systems with ease.

[Real-time Simulation Icon]

### Real-time Simulation

Observe system behavior with instant visual feedback from your circuit.

[Code Editor Icon]

### Integrated Code Editor

Write, test, and debug your firmware directly in the browser.

[Component Library Icon]

### Vast Component Library

Access a huge library of sensors, displays, and other modules.

[Sharing Icon]

### Collaboration & Sharing

Distribute and demonstrate projects easily via simple shareable links.

## How to Use Wokwi Simulation
1. **Connnect the Modules**
   * Follow the schematic diagram provided.
   * Use the left side (sketch.ino) to write your Arduino code.
2. ** Add Components**
   * Click the “+” button on the right side of the screen.
   * Select components such as LEDs, resistors, push buttons, sensors, etc.
   * Drag and drop the selected components into the virtual workspace.
3. **Wire the Components**
   * Click on a component's pin and drag a wire to the appropriate Arduino pin.
   * Ensure all connections match the schematic for correct functionality.
4. ** Run the Simulation**
   * Click the green "Play" button at the top to start the simulation.
   * Observe your circuit in action.
   * Click “Pause” to stop the simulation when needed.
5. ** Save or Share Your Project**
   * Click the Save icon to store your project.

## Изучили все тонкости и нюансы доставки грузов из Китая в Россию

**Мы точно знаем, как добиться от фабрики необходимого качества, как правильно перевести деньги за
товар и доставить его в Россию. Даже если речь идет о санкционных категориях.**

#### Как вы переводите деньги в Китай?
* Для начала мы объясняем фабрикам на китайском языке, как принять деньги из России в условиях
  санкций 
* Затем мы делаем юридически корректные документы для быстрого прохождения валютного контроля и
  последующей таможенной очистки в РФ. Готовим договор с поставщиком до запуска проекта, чтобы
  сократить время исполнения платежа 
* После этого отправляем деньги через наших агентов, за которых мы ручаемся
* А еще мы организуем закупку у фабрик без экспортной лицензии с помощью наших экспортных агентов в
  Китае, а также у фабрик, не готовых показывать связь с РФ

#### Как вы работаете с поставщиком?
* Мы организуем КОНТРАКТНОЕ производство. Т.е. товар на фабрике производится под вас. Это может быть
  как типовой товар, так и кастомизированный
* Следовательно, мы можем договориться и о кастомизации: от простой в виде логотипа до сложной в
  виде создания нового продукта

товар и доставить его в Россию. Даже если речь идет о санкционных категориях.**

#### Как вы переводите деньги в Китай?
* Для начала мы объясняем фабрикам на китайском языке, как принять деньги из России в условиях
  санкций 
* Затем мы делаем юридически корректные документы для быстрого прохождения валютного контроля и
  последующей таможенной очистки в РФ. Готовим договор с поставщиком до запуска проекта, чтобы
  сократить время исполнения платежа 
* После этого отправляем деньги через наших агентов, за которых мы ручаемся
* А еще мы организуем закупку у фабрик без экспортной лицензии с помощью наших экспортных агентов в
  Китае, а также у фабрик, не готовых показывать связь с РФ

### How to Publish in World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews

**Authors who wish to publish research or review articles in the international journal World Journal
of Advanced Research and Reviews should submit their manuscript via email attachment to:**

**Email: **[**editor@wjarr.com**][28]

Authors familiar with online submission systems may submit their manuscript through the online
submission link available on the journal website.

Before submission, authors should ensure that the manuscript follows the **WJARR author
guidelines**. Authors are required to send a covering letter and author declaration form. All
authors should also review the journal’s publication ethics and malpractice policy.

Submitted manuscripts must not have been published or submitted elsewhere. Only original and
plagiarism-free articles will be considered. All manuscripts undergo **double blind peer review**
and final decisions are based on quality, originality and contribution to existing knowledge.

An acknowledgement of manuscript submission will be sent to the corresponding author by email.
